content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Holds and supports affiliated independent managers running multi-strategy funds and separate accounts, same boutique model as the target."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Provides tax, valuation and advisory services for fees rather than managing investment portfolios."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager earning asset-based fees from funds and separate accounts sold to institutions and intermediaries."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Active investment manager earning advisory fees on mutual funds and separate accounts sold to advisers and institutions."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Sells regulatory filing software and document services to corporate issuers, not investment management."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Manages institutional client capital for management and performance fees, though focused on alternatives rather than traditional strategies."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Primarily sells research, ratings, data and software subscriptions; portfolio management is a minor line."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Focuses on private-markets fund-of-funds and venture or private lending, with interest income from loans, unlike public boutique managers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mainly investment processing software and outsourced operations for financial institutions, not core fund management."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment manager running separate accounts and pooled funds for wealthy clients and institutions, though it is more direct-to-client."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Software licensing and outsourced back-office operations for financial firms, not managing investment products."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Affiliated boutique managers selling funds and separate accounts through advisers and institutional channels, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Sponsors and manages ETFs and active funds for fees, though index licensing and digital tokenization are distinct sidelines."}]}
